prompt:
Hi — I'm Priya, brand manager for RawBite pet food. We're launching a new freeze-dried dog food product in January and need a lean, fast AI video ad for TikTok and Instagram Reels.

I've left my rough intake notes in the workspace under campaigns/Q1_launch/briefs/rawbite_intake_notes.txt. The concept, audience, budget ceiling, and platform targets are all in there.

I need you to produce a complete, ready-to-execute production plan document called rawbite_ad_production_plan.md. This document should cover everything our team needs to generate the visuals and animations — including the individual shot descriptions, the exact text prompts we'll feed into each tool, a log tracking what gets generated, and a final export summary. It also needs to include recommendations for what we'd improve in a second pass.

We're working with a tight credit budget so please keep that in mind throughout. The document needs to be usable as a direct handoff — no placeholders, no 'TBD' sections.
